name: Kroog
description: Kroog is a Yotian city and kingdom that was attacked and destroyed in the Brothers' War, and Kayla's birthplace, later a lake city ruled by the warlord Fask.

timeline.summary: Urza gives amulets to the healers of Kroog as a sign of friendship, drawing thousands to the city.
timeline.quote: Urza gave the healers of the city potent amulets

citation.text: Amulet of Kroog (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kroog is destroyed while most of its defenders are at Urza's side, and Urza vows that his allies will never need to fear for their defense again.
timeline.quote: After Kroog was destroyed while most of its defenders were at his side, Urza vowed that none of his allies would ever need to fear for their own defense again

citation.text: Yotian Soldier (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza gains the people of Kroog as allies and gives healers amulets.
timeline.quote: Among the first allies Urza gained were the people of Kroog.

citation.text: Amulet of Kroog (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kroog falls to Mishra's war machines.
timeline.quote: Those who believed the city of Kroog would never fall to Mishra's forces severely underestimated the might of his war machines.

citation.text: Dragon Engine (Masters Edition, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kayla remembers fleeing the fall of Kroog while pregnant.
timeline.quote: She fled the city, pregnant with her son.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Fask, the Tyrant of Kroog, rigs his chamber with strings of noisy objects because an oracle's curse haunts him.
timeline.quote: This was Fask's trap, his system to prove he was not mad but perceptive.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Fask sees a half-formed spirit at the foot of his bed and screams.
timeline.quote: Fask screamed.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi, whispering from the shadows, asks Kaya to pull him out because the Temporal Anchor undershot its target.
timeline.quote: The Temporal Anchor isn't calibrated correctly, Kaya, and I think we undershot our target

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kroog is attacked at dawn, and Sanwell and four other cadets stand in the orniary yard facing refurbished avengers, with Sanwell sick with nerves.
timeline.quote: Kroog died on a crimson morning.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: A huge explosion and a dragon engine appear over the city as Tawnos hurries away.
timeline.quote: Roiling crimson smoke leapt into the sky.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The pilots and their avengers push through burning streets, past bodies, to a plaza held by Yotian soldiers under Lieutenant Markos.
timeline.quote: Hold here, pilots!

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Fallaji troops attack the plaza barricade, and Llora orders Sanwell, Rica and Carlo to flank the dragon engine.
timeline.quote: Find a way to flank the engine and bring it down, pilot!

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The dragon engine's blast destroys the plaza, killing Llora, Markos, the other pilots and the soldiers.
timeline.quote: Llora and the other pilots, Lieutenant Markos and their soldiers—gone in a breath.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Sanwell and Rica drag a screaming Carlo away and reach a crossroads plaza, wondering where to run.
timeline.quote: Like Tawnos told us—if we're in danger, we run.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: A column of Fallaji brasscaps appears and Sanwell sends Sword One and Sword Two to attack.
timeline.quote: Sword One," Sanwell cried.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The two avengers slaughter the Fallaji front ranks, but Sword Two loses an arm and the Fallaji overrun Sword Two and Sword Three.
timeline.quote: The Fallaji brasscaps advanced, driven by their officers behind

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The Fallaji explode Sword Two's powerstone, burning Carlo and wounding Sanwell and Rica.
timeline.quote: The brasscaps detonated their bomb lances and killed Sword Two.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Fallaji crossbowmen kill the crawling Carlo as Sanwell and Rica hide.
timeline.quote: A flurry of crossbow bolts thudded into Carlo's back, killing him.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Sanwell orders Sword One to kill, and the wounded avenger rises from the dark as Sanwell throws down his rod and flees with Rica.
timeline.quote: Together, the two boys ran.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Aiman, a wounded Fallaji soldier pierced by three arrows, lies among the dead of Kroog crying for water.
timeline.quote: Three arrows. He'd been hit.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: At night Aiman sees a glowing blue ghost he takes for Death, which says it is too early and that it does not happen here, then vanishes.
timeline.quote: We're too early,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Two weeks later Aiman's fever breaks; he has lost an eye but survives.
timeline.quote: He had lost an eye

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi's spirit visits Kroog in 85 AR and sees a warlord scream about ghosts, then moves on.
timeline.quote: There, he watched a brutal man go mad and scream about ghosts and assassins.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi visits Kroog in 28 AR during the attack, and a dying Fallaji boy calls him Father.
timeline.quote: Father," the boy gasped. The boy died.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Traxos destroys the kingdom of Kroog during the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: The dragon engine known as the Scourge of Kroog earned its name when it destroyed the kingdom of Kroog during the Brothers' War.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Urza wins the contest in Kroog with an artificial warrior to marry Kayla.
timeline.quote: Urza's constructs an artificial warrior that he uses to win the contest

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Fall of Kroog, Tawnos frees Ashnod to protect Kayla, and Ashnod kills the Qadir with the staff and helps Tawnos and Kayla escape by boat.
timeline.quote: The Qadir himself she made sure to kill, draining his life with the staff such that he collapsed, bleeding.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza, under the patronage of the King of Kroog, develops a guild-like structure of apprentices.
timeline.quote: Urza, under the patronage of the King of Kroog, developed something akin to a guild structure

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 1: The Story of Urza and Mishra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Fallaji lure the Kroog forces deep into the Western Desert, leaving Kroog undefended.
timeline.quote: By luring the Kroog forces deeper into the Western Desert, the Fallaji accomplished two things

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 1: The Story of Urza and Mishra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kroog is destroyed by Dragon Engines, the first city destroyed by the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: Kroog was the first city, but certainly not the last, to be destroyed by the Brothers' War.

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 2: The Urza-Mishra War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza wins Kayla's hand by having his automaton move a great statue.
timeline.quote: Urza's automaton succeeded

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Life with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Kayla grow close after her father's death.
timeline.quote: the couple grew closer

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Life with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra convinces Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone and sleep with him; Urza discovers them, reclaims the stone and declares war.
timeline.quote: he convinced Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone and sleep with him

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Life with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra returns with his army and dragon engines and destroys Kroog; Kayla flees pregnant with Harbin.
timeline.quote: In one morning, Kroog was destroyed

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Life with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra attacks Kroog, left undefended by Urza's absence.
timeline.quote: allowing Mishra to launch an all-out attack on its capital

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Fall of Kroog, Tawnos frees Ashnod and returns the Staff of Zegon so she will protect Kayla.
timeline.quote: Ashnod was let free by Tawnos

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod drains the Qadir's life with the Staff of Zegon, killing him, and Mishra becomes the last Qadir.
timeline.quote: Mishra himself became the last Qadir.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza marries Kayla bin-Kroog, princess of Yotia.
timeline.quote: Urza marries Kayla bin-Kroog , the princess of Yotia .

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "Prelude". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A peace summit at Korlinda ends in disaster and the Warlord of Kroog dies, leaving Urza in charge.
timeline.quote: The Warlord of Kroog dies, leaving Urza in charge.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "Prelude". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Peace talks at Kroog end disastrously and mark the official start of the Brothers' War; the phyrexian demon enters Dominaria as Gix.
timeline.quote: a new peace conference in Kroog also ends disastrously and marks the official beginning of the Brothers' War .

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kroog is destroyed by dragon engines while Urza is stuck in the desert, and the Qadir of the Fallaji is killed.
timeline.quote: Kroog is destroyed by dragon engines while Urza is stuck in the desert.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
